from PIL import Image
im=Image.open('/app/chess_board.png').convert('RGB')
files='abcdefgh'
for r in range(8):
 for c in range(8):
  # estimate board color from a thin corner patch
  pts=[im.getpixel((c*80+x,r*80+y)) for y in range(2,10) for x in range(2,10)]
  bg=[sorted(p[k] for p in pts)[len(pts)//2] for k in range(3)]
  vals=[]
  for y in range(r*80+10,r*80+70):
   for x in range(c*80+10,c*80+70):
    p=im.getpixel((x,y)); vals.append(sum((p[k]-bg[k])**2 for k in range(3))**0.5)
  score=sum(v>22 for v in vals)/len(vals)
  if score<0.04: continue
  print('\n=== %s%d score %.2f bg %s ==='%(files[c],8-r,score,bg))
  # 16x16 blocks, print deviation from local background; high deviation is piece
  for yy in range(16):
   line=''
   for xx in range(16):
    ds=[]
    for y in range(r*80+yy*5,r*80+(yy+1)*5):
     for x in range(c*80+xx*5,c*80+(xx+1)*5):
      p=im.getpixel((x,y)); ds.append(sum((p[k]-bg[k])**2 for k in range(3))**0.5)
    d=sum(ds)/len(ds)
    line += ' .:-=+*#%@'[min(9,int(d/18))]
   print(line)
PY
